description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of two different models across a sequence of 19 points, indexed from 1 to 19 on the x-axis, which is labeled “#” and uses a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, also on a linear scale. The blue line, marked with circular data points and connected by dashed lines, starts at approximately 0.72 at x=1, rises to a peak of about 0.98 at x=11, and then remains relatively stable around 0.97–0.98 until the end at x=19. The green line, marked with square data points and connected by solid lines, begins at approximately 0.36 at x=1, rises to a peak of about 0.68 at x=7, then declines to a low of approximately 0.45 at x=9, rises again to about 0.65 at x=11, and then declines to about 0.5 at x=15 before rising sharply to 1.0 at x=17 and remaining at 1.0 through x=19. Both lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability at each data point.
